A '''clawfish''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. The name of the fish was commonly used when naming independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
